hero.title: RICHTER
hero.subtitle: Complete sound design for a short film. All sounds recorded from scratch - no libraries used. Made it work with basic recording gear.

overview.title: What I Did
overview.desc: Recorded and designed all sound for short film Richter. No libraries - everything came from field recordings (Zoom H6), synthesizers (Vital, ReaSynth, TAL Noisemaker), and manual foley work. Student budget, so I had to be creative with basic gear.
overview.field_desc: Recorded ambiences, room tones, and textures with a Zoom H6. Every sound in the film is an original recording - no library samples.
overview.synth_desc: Built drones and risers in Vital, ReaSynth, and TAL Noisemaker. The alarm sound is pure synthesis - no samples.
overview.foley_desc: Recorded footsteps on wood, concrete, and carpet. Door opens/closes. Paper handling. Cloth movement. Layered and processed in Cubase to match the picture.
overview.mix_desc: Balanced dialogue, SFX, and ambience. Automated volume and EQ to follow the story beats. Mixed in Reaper.

technical.title: How I Made It
technical.desc: Mixed in Reaper. Zoom H6 for field recording. Granular stretching in Cubase for tension textures. Wrote a short orchestral score (strings and brass) timed to scene cuts.

block1.title: Production Process
block1.content: Recorded footsteps on wood/concrete/carpet, door opens and closes, paper handling, cloth movement. Processed in Cubase with granular stretching for tension textures. Wrote a short orchestral score - strings and brass - timed to scene cuts.
